messages.content: I'm Arjun. I'm training for the Mumbai half marathon in January and I run 4 days a week.
Great goal, Arjun! Four days a week is a solid base for a half marathon.
I'm vegetarian, so any meal suggestions should be meat-free.
Understood, I'll only suggest vegetarian meals.
Bad news, I hurt my left knee today, so I've paused running and switched to swimming for now.
Sorry to hear that. Swimming is great low-impact cardio while your knee recovers.
Knee is better! I'm back to running, but only 3 days a week now.
Glad you're recovering. Three days a week is a sensible way to ease back in.

distractor_sessions: My friend Rohan is training for the Pune full marathon in December, he runs 6 days a week.
My brother eats chicken every day for protein, is that healthy?
Lean chicken can be part of a healthy diet in moderation.
I watched a documentary about ultramarathons yesterday, wild stuff.
Ultramarathons really are amazing feats of endurance.
